Container.Name: shoebox
Container.Overview: Shoebox: a tiny catalog for the shoes at home (kids/adult, size, photo, note). Optimised for adding shoes quickly with a smartphone. Photos are stored as plain JPEGs in one subfolder per size inside the photo path. Internal use only, no login.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI. Open http://SERVER-IP:PORT on your phone.

Config.Name: Photo path
Config.Description: Where the shoe photos are stored. One subfolder per size is created automatically, e.g. /photos/32/00012_kids.jpg

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the files (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the files (100 = users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File permission mask for new files and folders.
